brief.title: HackTheNorth final demo — three camera takes
brief.objective: Film only the requested 5 s walking reveal, 5 s truck-left zoom, and 11 s doorway/time-freeze finale. Use normal camera aim; reveal lower body to head in the first take. These are 21 seconds of source takes for the final demo.

document.title: HackTheNorth final demo — three camera takes
document.logline: Our camera follows the idea, changes perspective, and catches us losing track of time.

scenes.title: Walking reveal

shots.action: Both presenters walk ahead of the robot, facing forward; the robot follows behind and films their backs. Travel 0.55 m during 0–4 s, then hold for 4–5 s while completing the lower-body-to-head reveal. Average speed over the five-second take is 0.11 m/s; moving speed is approximately 0.1375 m/s, the current motor model's minimum. Camera movement is scripted, with no live person tracking.
shots.camera_intent: Initialize the arms, then execute the authored camera movement. No human detection, centering, or tracking. No added camera pitch offset; keep the horizon level.
shots.light_intent: Execute the authored light-arm pose without tracking people.
shots.edit_intent: Cut at five seconds. No reset footage in the edit.

scenes.title: Left-side camera, then zoom

shots.action: Initialize the camera facing the presenters on the robot's left, aimed at neck level (1.50 m in the illustrative scene). Hold both arm poses relative to the cart; do not turn toward or track any person. Keep the cart's original forward travel direction. Hold 24 mm for 0–2 seconds, zoom to 180 mm during 2–3 seconds, then hold 180 mm until the five-second take ends.

scenes.title: The deadline

shots.action: Robot starts inside facing the entrance, opposite its forward travel. Record while parked for 0–3 s as presenters open the door and enter. Move forward into the building with them at 3–5 s, requesting 0.30 m/s cruise with a 0.275 m/s pace cap to preserve the two-second ramped move. Park at 5 s and hold the arm pose. At 5–10 s presenters freeze while the background appears to rush past in the edit. Snap at 10 s, return to normal, deliver the line, and stop recording at 11 s.
shots.camera_intent: Initialize the arms, then execute the authored camera movement. No human detection, centering, or tracking. No added camera pitch offset; keep the horizon level.
shots.light_intent: Execute the authored light-arm pose without tracking people.
shots.edit_intent: Time-rush background is a masked post-production effect at 5–10 s. Snap at 10 s; dry dialogue to 11 s.

visual_style.visual_rules: Three independent takes. Use the authored camera aim without an added pitch offset. No extra product-demo shots.
visual_style.palette: Natural campus colors; consistent wardrobe across all three takes.
visual_style.lighting: Available exterior and lobby light; keep faces readable.
visual_style.wardrobe: Keep each actor's clothing and held props consistent.
visual_style.sound: Footsteps, door opening, a rising time-rush sound, a dry finger snap and the final line.
continuity_locks: Reset the robot between takes, outside recording.
